title: Flip & Rip Fishing Charters
specs: Targets Snook, Tarpon, Jack Crevalle, Barracuda, and Snapper
blurb: Flip & Rip Fishing Charters offers guided saltwater inshore fishing trips aboard a 22-foot Pathfinder bay boat. Trips cater to anglers of all skill levels and include all gear, fishing licenses, and live bait when available. They offer 4, 6, and 8 hour trips for groups of 3-4 people with options for additional persons.
highlights: Targets Snook, Tarpon, Jack Crevalle, Barracuda, and Snapper

quotes.text: HUGE! shout out to Mike Tog with Flip and Rip charters! We had an absolute blast this weekend! I can’t thank them enough, and if anyone is ever anywhere near West Palm, make sure to check with Mike and see if he is available to take you out. This man is an absolute menace to the fish, no matter what he’s targeting!
